description: This file declares the BrokerClientImpl class, which implements the BrokerClient interface for managing broker connections, message handling, and configuration in a network transport context within the prplMesh project.

classes.name: BrokerClientImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the BrokerClient interface for managing broker communication, message exchange, and network interface configuration.

methods.name: BrokerClientImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the broker client with connection, parser, serializer, and event loop.

methods.name: ~BrokerClientImpl
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up broker client resources.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to specific CMDU message types from the broker.

methods.name: configure_interfaces
methods.description: Configures network interfaces and bridges for transport.

methods.name: configure_al_mac
methods.description: Sets the local al_mac address for transport.

methods.name: configure_primary_vlan_id
methods.description: Sets the primary VLAN ID for transport.

methods.name: send_cmdu
methods.description: Sends a CMDU message to the transport process.

methods.name: forward_cmdu
methods.description: Forwards a received CMDU message for dispatch.

methods.name: handle_read
methods.description: Handles socket read events and processes incoming data.

methods.name: handle_message
methods.description: Processes received transport messages, handling CMDUs.

methods.name: close_connection
methods.description: Closes the connection and cleans up event handlers.

methods.name: send_cmdu_message
methods.description: Serializes and sends a CMDU message over the network.

methods.name: send_message
methods.description: Serializes and transmits a transport message.
